hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|]) *(sudo +)?(dnf|yum|rpm|apt|apt-get|flatpak) +(install|remove|erase|reinstall)|pip3? +install|(npm|pnpm|yarn) +(install|i|add) +(-g|--global)|curl[^|]*\|[^|]*(sh|bash)|wget[^|]*\|[^|]*(sh|bash)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"This command appears to install software. Check whether ~/dotfiles (setup.sh, packages/dnf-userinstalled.txt) should be updated and committed to reflect it."}}'; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); home="$HOME"; case "$f" in "$home"/dotfiles/*|"$home"/.dotfiles-backup/*|"$home"/.claude/jobs/*|"$home"/.claude/projects/*|"$home"/.claude/sessions/*|"$home"/.claude/cache/*|"$home"/.claude/downloads/*|"$home"/.claude/backups/*|"$home"/.claude/shell-snapshots/*|"$home"/.claude/session-env/*|"$home"/.claude/.credentials.json|"$home"/.claude/history.jsonl|"$home"/.claude/.last-cleanup|"$home"/.zsh_history|"$home"/.bash_history) ;; "$home"/.*|"$home"/.config/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"This edits a dotfile/config under the home directory. Check whether ~/dotfiles (stow packages: zsh, bash, git, claude) should be updated to track this change, and commit if so."}}' ;; esac
